sector_model: small property-casualty insurer: P/E on operating earnings, price to book, combined ratio, reserve development, catastrophe load, reinsurance dependence; FCF and EV not used
thesis: Kingstone (Nasdaq: KINS) is a small New York homeowners and personal lines insurer. Q3 2026 (to 2026-09-30): net income 17.6M ($1.19 vs $0.74), net combined ratio 65.6% (72.7%), direct premiums written 86.8M (+14.5%); nine months net income 27.2M ($1.86 vs $1.82), combined ratio 81.7% (79.0%) with catastrophe load 10.4 points (0.8) and favorable prior year development 3.8 points. Underlying combined ratio 75.1% nine months. 2026 guidance raised on the low end: EPS 2.70-2.90, combined ratio 79-83%, ROE 29-30%. Balance sheet 2026-09-30: investments 337.1M, cash 20.8M, total liabilities 352.0M, debt 3.5M, equity 136.7M (diluted book value 9.21/share, 10.43 excluding AOCI of about -18.2M unrealized bond losses). Close 23.23 on 2026-11-12 (two publishers agree): market cap about 336M, 2.5x diluted book, 8.0x TTM GAAP EPS (TTM net income 42.0M = FY25 40.8M minus 26.0M plus 27.2M), 8.3x guided 2026 EPS midpoint 2.80. Nine-month operating cash flow 59.3M. The shares have risen from 13.83 to a near 52-week high (23.42) as ROE exceeded 28%. Cheap on earnings but priced at 2.5x book for an insurer whose 2026 ROE is well above its history and whose Q3 combined ratio of 65.6% is unusually low; the market may be applying a cautious multiple for thin size, cat and reinsurance exposure.
counterthesis: A combined ratio of 65.6% in Q3 with 7.5 points of catastrophe load and 6.1 points of favorable reserve release is not a run rate; nine-month net income grew only 4.8% and the nine-month combined ratio worsened to 81.7% from 79.0%. Earnings depend on reinsurance that cedes premium and may reprice; a single Northeast storm season could erase a year. A 2.5x book multiple already prices high ROE persistence. A 28-30% ROE on a 137M equity base, favorable development and unrealized bond losses (AOCI -18.2M) mean book value is sensitive. Small float (14.5M shares, market cap 336M), history of earlier losses and a Form 144 insider sale notice filed 2026-11-12 (unread) add risk. Reserve adequacy, reinsurance terms, geographic concentration, debt covenants and the 10-K were not read.
invalidation: Valuation case would need price near 1.5-1.8x book without deterioration, or evidence that underlying combined ratio below 76% persists through a bad cat year. Thesis fails if the underlying combined ratio rises above 82%, reserve development turns adverse, reinsurance renewal costs jump, or book value falls on reserve strengthening.
